First-Time Buyers

Your first home, without the fear.

Rebates, savings programs and a step-by-step plan — everything first-time buyers in Ontario need, explained in plain language.

Money on the table

Programs built for you.

i.

LTT Rebates

Up to $4,000 provincial + $4,475 Toronto land transfer tax back for first-time buyers.

ii.

FHSA

Save up to $40,000 tax-free toward your down payment with a First Home Savings Account.

iii.

RRSP HBP

Withdraw up to $60,000 from your RRSP tax-free under the Home Buyers' Plan.

iv.

30-Yr Amortization

First-time buyers can stretch insured mortgages to 30 years for lower monthly payments.

Program limits change — Ash will confirm current amounts and eligibility in your consultation.
